scope: Litha computer control research, implementation review and evaluation design
note: Some sources are intentionally referenced by more than one chapter. Entries are not a count of independent experiments.

sources.title: Computer Use product documentation
supported_claims: Local product supports graphical interaction on macOS and Windows where available.
Windows uses the active desktop foreground.
Prefer dedicated integrations for repeatable operations.
sources.limitations: Product documentation; does not establish this account entitlement or speed on Litha tasks.

sources.title: Let Claude use your computer in Cowork
supported_claims: Product describes connectors, browser, then screen interaction.
Desktop computer use documented on macOS and Windows.
Direct screen interaction acts on the applications without a desktop sandbox boundary.
sources.limitations: Product beta and account availability change; no measured Litha comparison.

sources.title: Use Claude Cowork on web, desktop, and mobile
supported_claims: Cloud task execution differs from local access.
Local files, browser, and computer use require the desktop app to remain available.
sources.limitations: Plan lists varied between indexed snapshots; report avoids exact entitlement promises.

sources.title: Responses computer use
supported_claims: Code execution and structured computer action paths are documented.
API conversation and execution environment state are separate.
A generated call marked completed still requires application execution.
sources.limitations: Examples were inspected, not live-run; model access and supported tools must be checked per project.

sources.title: Agents API hosted computer use
supported_claims: Hosted browser has a session/event lifecycle.
Recover the existing session after disconnection before retrying a task.
Unknown acknowledgment requires reconciliation of current session state.
sources.limitations: Hosted browser is distinct from controlling the owner Windows desktop.

sources.title: Computer use tool
supported_claims: Current entry computer_toolset_20260801.
Ordered member calls carry toolset_name computer.
Stop at first failure and return results for every member.
Legacy display dimension arguments are rejected by the new entry.
sources.limitations: Version-specific contract; must not apply older examples mechanically.

sources.title: Browser use tool
supported_claims: Page-aware references and tab state complement screenshots.
An observation may be attached to a permitted action result.
Tab-management result content has a distinct browser_state shape.
sources.limitations: Viewport coordinates and browser element references differ from desktop display pixels.

sources.title: Latency optimization
supported_claims: Reduce unnecessary model requests.
Parallelize independent work.
Use ordinary code when model inference is unnecessary.
Evaluate quality and latency tradeoffs on actual workloads.
sources.limitations: Illustrative percentages are not Litha benchmarks or guaranteed improvements.

sources.title: Browser and desktop drivers
supported_claims: Computer actions run in order and the helper does not retry driver actions.
Cropped screenshot coordinates require scale and origin mapping.
Browser CSS pixels differ from display pixels.
Uncertain effects need authoritative-state inspection before retry.
sources.limitations: SDK example checks do not prove native Windows driver behavior.

sources.title: Browser and computer use with SDK toolsets
supported_claims: Drivers own image resizing and coordinate validation.
Zoom does not change the full screenshot coordinate frame.
Input checks and action limits remain executor responsibilities.
sources.limitations: Do not apply a generic crop offset to full-frame zoom coordinates.

sources.title: Computer use integration recipes
supported_claims: Original screenshot detail recommended for computer use.
Resize when model limits require it and remap coordinates.
Local driver rehearsals can run without API calls.
sources.limitations: Resolution recommendations are not verified optimal for Roblox Studio or Blender.

sources.title: Tool use with prompt caching
supported_claims: Toolset cache breakpoints apply after its definition.
A breakpoint within an action batch takes effect at the end of that batch.
Changes to tool/configuration prefixes can invalidate cache.
sources.limitations: API prompt cache is distinct from local KV reuse; measure rather than infer savings.

sources.title: Mitigate jailbreaks and prompt injections
supported_claims: Keep third-party content in identifiable tool results.
Describe source and provenance.
Limit accessible data and action scope.
sources.limitations: Structured wrapping and model classification do not prove content safe or authorized.

sources.title: UI Automation Control Patterns Overview
sources.supported_finding: Patterns expose control capabilities; support can change dynamically.
sources.verification: Opened primary page; no runtime performance reproduction.

sources.title: Caching UI Automation Properties and Control Patterns
sources.supported_finding: Bulk fetching reduces per-property cross-process calls; cached-only references cannot invoke; updated cache does not mutate existing references.
sources.verification: Opened primary page; no runtime performance reproduction.

sources.title: Subscribing to UI Automation Events
sources.supported_finding: Scoped events reduce polling; providers do not necessarily raise every event.
sources.verification: Opened primary page; no runtime performance reproduction.

sources.title: Understanding Threading Issues
sources.supported_finding: UIA client thread and COM MTA guidance; event registration/removal must not race across threads.
sources.verification: Opened primary page; no runtime performance reproduction.

sources.title: SetForegroundWindow
sources.supported_finding: Foreground activation is restricted and may fail; verify actual focus.
sources.verification: Opened primary page; no runtime performance reproduction.

sources.title: SendInput
sources.supported_finding: Returns inserted count; UIPI boundary and ambiguous failure causes; current key state matters.
sources.verification: Opened primary page; no runtime performance reproduction.

sources.title: Understanding Screen Scaling Issues
sources.supported_finding: UIA uses physical coordinates; DPI virtualization requires an explicit mapping.
sources.verification: Opened primary page; no runtime performance reproduction.

sources.title: MOUSEINPUT
sources.supported_finding: Absolute normalized coordinates and virtual desktop flag semantics.
sources.verification: Opened primary page; no runtime performance reproduction.

sources.title: Desktop Duplication API
sources.supported_finding: DXGI frames, dirty/move rectangles, reconstruction order, cursor/rotation handling.
sources.verification: Opened primary page; no runtime performance reproduction.

sources.title: Playwright Locators
sources.supported_finding: Semantic locators and test identifiers are preferred to brittle DOM-structure selectors; locators re-resolve.
sources.verification: Opened primary page; no runtime performance reproduction.

sources.title: Playwright Auto-waiting
sources.supported_finding: Action-specific readiness checks and timeouts; click checks uniqueness, visibility, stability, events and enabled state.
sources.verification: Opened primary page; no runtime performance reproduction.

sources.title: Playwright BrowserType persistent contexts
sources.supported_finding: User data directory ownership; multiple simultaneous instances cannot share it; default everyday Chrome profile automation is unsupported for this launch mechanism.
sources.verification: Opened primary page; no runtime performance reproduction.

sources.title: Connect to Roblox Studio MCP server
sources.supported_finding: Built-in local stdio MCP, script/data-model/playtest/capture/input tools, server enablement and explicit studio_id per call.
sources.verification: Opened primary page; no runtime performance reproduction.

sources.title: StudioTestService
sources.supported_finding: Plugin-security Run, Play, multiplayer test methods and returned test values.
sources.verification: Opened primary page; no runtime performance reproduction.

sources.title: Blender Using Operators official source
sources.supported_finding: Context-dependent operators and poll failures; direct API approaches can avoid inappropriate operator contexts.
sources.verification: Read complete official source through GitHub connector after docs-site direct retrieval failed; indexed official docs agree.

sources.title: Blender command-line arguments, 5.4 documentation
sources.supported_finding: Background/Python invocation and --python-exit-code semantics; installed-version compatibility must be checked.
sources.verification: Indexed official primary documentation retrieved by search; direct page fetch returned 402. No claim this version is installed or stable.

sources.title: Blender threading official source
sources.supported_finding: Blender Python integration is not thread-safe; long-lived threads can crash Blender; independent-process alternative.
sources.verification: Read complete official source through GitHub connector after docs-site direct retrieval failed; indexed official docs agree.

sources.title: Microsoft UFO repository snapshot
sources.supported_finding: Hybrid native/UI control and speculative multi-action design; 51% fewer calls is an author claim, not a reproduced Litha measurement.
sources.verification: Opened README/documentation and verified main commit with GitHub connector. Author performance claims not reproduced.

sources.title: Microsoft UFO hybrid GUI/API actions
sources.supported_finding: Application APIs and UI automation routed through hybrid action infrastructure.
sources.verification: Opened README/documentation and verified main commit with GitHub connector. Author performance claims not reproduced.

sources.title: Microsoft OmniParser repository snapshot
sources.supported_finding: Screenshot target parsing; latest README distinguishes v3 YOLOv9 MIT-based detector, legacy AGPL detector weights, MIT captions and CC-BY-4.0 repository.
sources.verification: Opened README and repository license label; verified master commit with GitHub connector. Exact model/checkpoint license should be reviewed before adoption.

sources.verification: Read the local source snapshot fetched by root; native Windows path not executed.

sources.title: OSWorld original project and version announcements
findings: Original 369-task set and possible 361-task variant
Separate Verified and 2.0 announcements
limitations: Different releases and task counts are not directly interchangeable

sources.title: OSWorld 2.0 paper v2
findings: 108 long-horizon workflows
Binary completion and partial progress differ
Reported human duration and tool-call counts are configuration-specific
limitations: Does not measure Litha or its target hardware

sources.title: OSWorld-V2 repository
findings: Pin matching code, tasks, assets, websites, provider images
Historical README instructions remain alongside active recommendations
limitations: Main is mutable; use the named manifest for actual runs

sources.title: OSWorld benchmark release policy
findings: Concrete resolved versions and integrity checks distinguish comparable runs
Active manifests should not be silently changed
limitations: Policy text is not evidence that any particular run obeyed it

sources.title: OSWorld-Human paper v2
findings: Temporal performance study identifies planning/reflection/judging latency
Revised abstract reports 2.7–4.3x excess steps
limitations: README retains a different 1.4–2.7x range; do not merge ranges
Reported effects are study-specific

sources.title: OSWorld-Human repository
findings: Human reference action trajectories for efficiency scoring
Explicit instruction not to train on evaluation solutions
limitations: README result range differs from revised paper

sources.title: Windows Agent Arena repository
findings: Real Windows evaluation; normal and hard modes differ
Full-suite duration uses parallel VMs
Historical cost table is not current pricing
limitations: Suite throughput is not one-agent task latency

sources.title: BrowserGym repository
findings: Shared research environment across web benchmarks
limitations: Browser success does not establish native desktop success

sources.title: WebArena repository
findings: Self-hostable web task environment
limitations: Dataset and environment revision affect comparisons

sources.title: VisualWebArena repository
findings: Tasks require multimodal interpretation of web content
limitations: Visual-web coverage does not cover native applications

sources.title: WebArena-Verified repository
findings: Audited tasks/evaluators and structural comparison
Offline evaluation from recorded network traces
812 full tasks and 258 hard-subset tasks
limitations: Recorded-run rescoring is distinct from offline interaction

sources.title: WorkArena repository
findings: Atomic and compositional ServiceNow tasks
Current setup requires approved instance-resource access
limitations: Not a ready-to-run offline benchmark without setup/access

sources.title: AgentLab repository
findings: Explicit handling of job timeouts
Shared-instance task dependencies affect parallel evaluation
limitations: Suggested concurrency depends on memory and workload; not a Litha target

sources.title: Agent S3 usage documentation
findings: Separate generation and grounding configuration
Example CLI is explicitly without multi-rollout selection
Grounding coordinate resolutions must match configuration
limitations: Example run differs from highest published multi-rollout score

sources.title: Scaling Agents for Computer Use
findings: Behavior-based selection across multiple rollouts
Reported 72.6% OSWorld result uses scaling method
limitations: Not equivalent to single-rollout latency or universal human-level capability

sources.title: Evolving Agent Interfaces
findings: Interface evolution from synthetic task experience with held-out validation
Reported 21.3% binary score with Qwen3.8-27B on OSWorld V2
limitations: Author-reported experimental result; no Litha speed/hardware evidence

sources.title: Agent S4 implementation documentation
findings: Separate interface repository, bounded edit scope and budget
Tracked dispatch and validation reevaluation
Separate train, validation, and held-out test sets
limitations: Documented design is not an independent audit of all code paths

sources.title: OpenCUA repository
findings: Distinct online task, grounding, and offline action evaluations
Current vLLM guidance and model-specific loading requirements
limitations: Single-GPU example does not establish 8 GB VRAM fit
Old headline claims remain historical

sources.title: UI-TARS repository
findings: Separate task and grounding benchmark tables
Explicit step budgets for reported task results
limitations: Grounding accuracy and task completion are different metrics

sources.title: OmniParser repository
findings: Screen parsing for downstream GUI agents
limitations: Parsing is not task verification or a complete controller
